item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00464","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C24","C16","C04"],"selected_candidate_label":"C24","confidence":0.86,"relationship_type":"structural_functional_template","rationale":"C24 plausibly supplied a concrete campaign-letter template: designate or enlist governmental leaders for a United Defense Fund/USO appeal, request their active cooperation, and justify the appeal as essential to the morale and welfare of the armed forces. The child adapts this machinery from federal and District officials supporting a National Capital campaign to governors serving as honorary chairmen in their jurisdictions. C16 and C04 share the same fundraising program and governmental-cooperation structure, but less closely match the child's chairman-based appeal.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"I am asking each State and Territorial Governor to serve as Honorary Chairman for the United Defense Fund in his State or Territory.","parent_excerpt":"For the fall Red Feather Campaign for the Community Chest Federation and the United Defense Fund-USO in the National Capital Area I have approved the appointment of the Honorable Douglas McKay, Secretary of the Interior, as Chairman for the Government Unit.","explanation":"Both install senior governmental figures in campaign-chairman roles for a United Defense Fund/USO appeal, with the child adapting the assignment to every state and territory."},{"child_excerpt":"In the task of marshalling this support, we hope to enlist as leaders the official heads of State and Territorial Governments.","parent_excerpt":"I ask that you give him your fullest measure of support and assistance. All persons in authority in the Federal and District Government, I am sure, will extend their complete cooperation to this important charitable appeal.","explanation":"The operative mechanism is parallel: mobilize governmental leadership and cooperation behind the charitable campaign."},{"child_excerpt":"If we are to maintain the United Defense Services--particularly those of the USO--on the desired high level, the understanding and support of the American people are vital.","parent_excerpt":"These programs are essential to the morale and happiness of our men and women of the Armed Forces both at home and overseas.","explanation":"Both justify support for the same UDF/USO programs through their importance to armed-forces morale and welfare."}]}
